title: The Summer of Junebug Creek
author: Sebastian Joubert
blurb: Lena Quintana, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
